card.name: Digits inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a multi-digit or decimal number, usually a dose strength or ratio, such as the 0 in 200 mg or the 5 in 0.5 mg. It is most common in tablet counts and dose ranges.

modes.label: Tablet strength digits
modes.description: The last zero or digit of a tablet strength given in parentheses after a tablet count.

modes.description: A digit after a decimal point or in a fraction or ratio in a dose or formula.
modes.example: should be progressively adjusted in increments/decrements of 2 mg/0.<<5>> mg or 4 mg/1 mg
